DRAFT – requires salesperson approval – availability unconfirmed
Not sendable as an offer

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. As specified, we can't meet this request. Our largest room is the Loft, which holds at most 24 people, and you asked for 50. The Studio holds at most 12, so it doesn't fit either.

I can't confirm anything, and nothing is held. The total price you suggested can't be applied, because our listed prices are fixed. Confirming a booking and changing the pricing are not things I can do in this message. Your enquiry didn't state a duration, so I have assumed our standard 4-hour block, and I have included the venue only, with no extras. We only offer 4-hour bookings. Any date would need a separate availability check.

There is one alternative you would have to agree to. It means giving up part of your request:



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Loft | 24 | €420 | headcount reduced from 50 to at most 24; budget raised from €100 to €420 (+€320) |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



This option is the Loft with no more than 24 people. That is fewer than the 50 you asked for, and the cost would be above your budget, as the table shows.

If you can tell me your preferred headcount, the length of the event and any extras you need (catering, projector, facilitator), I can put together a proper proposal for you to review. If you need accessibility, please let me know. The Loft is wheelchair accessible, but the Studio has stairs only.

Kind regards
